Help.Title: KeeStashDock — User guide
Help.Content:
## What is KeeStashDock
A lightweight text dock: stash snippets from anywhere, find them instantly, and act on selected text in any application. Everything lives in a portable Data folder next to the app - no installation.

## Quick panel
Press the global hotkey (default Alt+Q, changeable in Settings) to show the panel. Type in the quick input and press Enter to stash; type in the search box to filter; click a card to copy it back to the clipboard. Each stash can carry an expiry: never, 1 day, 7 days, or burn after read - expired snippets move to the trash automatically.

## Pinning
Click a card's pin to keep it at hand: the pin turns solid and accent-colored. Click again to unpin. The workbench's Pinned view collects them all.

## Selection bubble
Enable it under Settings > Behavior: select text in any application and a small bubble appears beside it. Choose its action: copy the selection into KeeStashDock, or translate it into the app language.

## Selection translate
The translation appears on a glass card; click the card to copy it. Four engines: Google (default), Bing, and Lingva work without any key; DeepL needs your own API key (free/pro tier detected from the key suffix).

## Bubble appearance
Bubble style: Default (soft black & white - white surface, black ink), Follow theme, or one of ten pinned palettes (Ivory, Graphite, ...). Text glow and drop shadow toggle independently; the opacity slider at 100% makes the glass fully opaque, curing any bleed-through.

## Clipboard history
Off by default. Enable it under Settings > Behavior and every text copy in any application lands as a snippet (source: clipboard). Switching it off stops collection instantly. Empty and oversized content is skipped; a duplicate merely bumps the existing snippet to the top.

## Direct paste
Off by default. When on, clicking a card also pastes it straight into the window you came from - no manual switch-and-Ctrl+V.

## Workbench
The panel's expand button opens the workbench: browse All / Pinned / groups / Trash, full-text search, and edit title, body, and comma-separated tags in place. Right-click a group to rename it, delete it (snippets move to Uncategorized), or delete it with contents (snippets go to the trash, recoverable). The Transform menu offers UPPER/lower case, whitespace collapse, line-break removal, JSON formatting, and URL/Base64 encode-decode.

## Group import/export and presets
Groups export as .ksdgrp files and import on another machine, with overwrite-or-rename on name conflicts. Preset groups import seven command collections in one click: Git, Docker, Linux Shell, PowerShell, npm/Node.js, Python/pip, and SQL.

## Sticky notes and QR
Drag a card from the panel onto the desktop to tear it out as a floating sticky note (opacity adjustable). Right-click a card to generate a QR code and take the text with your phone camera (up to 1800 characters).

## Appearance
Light / dark / follow-system theme; an optional panel background image with scrim, frosted glass, and edge glow, each adjustable. Text color schemes: Auto derives readable colors from your wallpaper region by region; presets and Custom (with a color picker) force one palette everywhere.

## Languages
20 interface languages, switchable live in Settings; Arabic mirrors the whole layout right-to-left automatically. Language packs are open JSON files - translators can edit and hit Reload.

## Data and backup
Everything lives in the portable Data folder next to the app. Settings > Data exports/imports a data package (a safety backup is made before any import). Scheduled automatic backups run every 24 hours by default (interval adjustable from 6 hours to 7 days, rolling retention) into Data\Backups.
